meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 装上后,当你问起 Senpi 提示(Tip)时,Claude 不再凭记忆回答,而是先查证再解释:它运行命令获取提示列表,检查你实际能看到哪些提示,再去读功能代码,最后用你提问的语言给出深入具体的解释,并附上代码路径。
howto.when: 当你提到 "Tip:" 提示、说 "give-me-tips"、问某条提示是什么意思或怎么用等时触发。

say.text: 我看到的 Tip: 'xxx' 是什么意思?
say.note: Claude 会深入解释这条提示的具体机制。
触发技能,开始解释提示。

say.text: 我现在能看到哪些提示?
say.note: Claude 会列出你个人可见的提示。

howto.what_en: After install, when you ask about a Senpi tip, Claude verifies first: it fetches the live tip list, checks which tips you personally can see, reads the actual code, then explains deeply in your language, citing file paths.
howto.when_en: When you mention a 'Tip:' line, say 'give-me-tips', ask what a tipped feature does, how it works, or which tips are visible to you.

say_en.note: Claude will explain that tip in depth.
Triggers the skill to start explaining.

say_en.text: Which tips can I see right now?
say_en.note: Claude lists the tips visible to you.
